transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount for a library management system, ensuring that only authenticated members can borrow or return books (TRU-01) and that all transactions are logged for auditability (TRU-02). Protecting member personal data through encryption (TRU-03) and implementing role-based access control (TRU-04) enhances security. Additionally, securely managing overdue books (TRU-05) and allowing members to update their information (TRU-06) are essential for privacy. Strong password policies (TRU-07) further safeguard accounts against unauthorized access. These requirements collectively ensure a secure and trustworthy environment for all users.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously to maintain resource availability.
The system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books within 24 hours of the due date to ensure accountability.
The system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
The system shall provide an accessible interface for all users to promote fairness and inclusivity.
